---
applyTo: "apps/mobile/**"

# Mobile app instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md`.

- Respect mobile bootstrap, providers, navigation, and feature boundaries.
- Import `@nexus/*` via public APIs only.
- Do not import `@sujeetd7/ai-engineering-*` into mobile runtime.
- UI via `@nexus/shared-ui` (Tamagui-backed). No MUI/Tailwind token systems.
